label.description: The accessible name, required: an action button is icon-first, so its name is not on screen. It is NOT also the tooltip — see hint.

hint.description: The tooltip, and the whole of it: title is this and nothing else. It used to fall back to label, so EVERY button got a tooltip whether or not its name was already on screen and a reader heard the name twice. Now each call site decides: pass hint on an icon-only button or one whose visible label ellipses, where a tooltip carrying the name is the standard affordance and hint equal to label is the right answer; leave it empty wherever the text is already fully visible.

icon.description: The glyph, by its name in the kit's manifest. Empty for a text-only action button.

mirror.description: Draw the glyph flipped horizontally: one shipped glyph serves both sides of a pair.

weight.description: The glyph's weight: regular, bold or fill. A selected toggle draws fill by convention.

toggles.description: A two-state button: selected flips on activation and aria-pressed says which state it is in.

selected.description: The pressed or chosen state, and the ONLY thing the selected drawing follows — whoever wrote it. A host that owns the selection sets it with toggles off and the button draws selected without flipping itself or emitting change; with toggles on the button also flips it on activation. What selected does NOT do is announce anything by itself: aria-pressed comes from toggles and aria-checked from checked, so a host-owned segment that must be announced is a checked radio (and setting checked also draws it selected, so the two never disagree).

checked.description: Empty for a plain button; true or false for one segment of a radio group, which then carries role=radio and aria-checked on its control, is drawn selected while it is true, and puts role=none on the HOST so the radio is the radiogroup's own child rather than a grandchild behind a generic. It is the ALTERNATIVE to toggles, not a companion: a button that is one of several mutually exclusive choices is a radio, a button that is independently on or off is a toggle. Setting both is not a second opinion but a refusal — checked wins, so no aria-pressed is written on a radio (it is not a state of that role) and the button does not flip itself either.

tabindex.description: Forwarded to the inner control as its tabindex, which is what makes a roving caret possible: the focusable node is the button inside, not the host, so a group moving focus writes this rather than reaching into a child's internals. It is a PROPERTY ONLY (el.tabindex = "0") and deliberately not an observed attribute: written as an attribute it would land on the host as well, and a host carrying tabindex is itself focusable, so the one control would become two tab stops. Write tabindex on the host and you get the platform's meaning — the host is the tab stop and nothing reaches the control.

quiet.description: No fill and no border until hovered, which is what a toolbar wants. Off for a standalone tool button.

emphasized.description: Draws the selected state in the accent rather than a neutral fill.

loading.description: Working on the last activation: the click is swallowed, the glyph gives way to a spinner, and aria-busy says so. An action button draws its icon from a name and has no icon slot, so this is the only way a host can put a spinner where the glyph was.

stacked.description: Icon above the label, the label visible and small: the shape of a rail button. The label is then on screen, so it is the accessible name by itself.

labelledby.description: Forwarded to the inner control as aria-labelledby: the id of the visible text that names this button, when something on screen already does.

describedby.description: Forwarded to the inner control as aria-describedby: the id of a description beside the name, which is where a jx-tooltip's id goes.

haspopup.description: What the button opens instead of running a command: menu, dialog or listbox. Forwarded to the control as aria-haspopup.

expanded.description: Whether what haspopup names is showing. Forwarded to the control as aria-expanded, only when haspopup is set.

badge.description: A count or a mark drawn over the button's corner; empty for none.

popovertarget.description: The popover this button invokes; forwarded to the inner control.

popovertargetaction.description: toggle, show or hide; forwarded with popovertarget.

command.description: The invoker command this button sends; forwarded to the inner control.

commandfor.description: The element the command is sent to; forwarded to the inner control.

onSwallow.description: The swallow, on the INNER CONTROL rather than the host: stopPropagation halts an event at the node it is called on and every node after it, not the other listeners on that same node — so a swallow on the host cancels the default and then runs the host's own click listeners anyway, which is the one path a consumer actually uses. Called one node earlier, the click never reaches the host at all.

emits.name: change
emits.description: A toggling button flipped; detail is the new selected state.

onClick.description: A toggling button flips selected and says so with change. A plain one leaves the click to the host, which listens for it on the element. The loading branch is the second half of the swallow: a click dispatched at the HOST never passes the inner control, so this is the only guard that sees it.

& > [part=\"control\"].transition: background var(--jx-dur-1) var(--jx-ease-out), color var(--jx-dur-1) var(--jx-ease-out)
